high_level_description: The image shows an open book or document placed on a red fabric with a patterned design. The book is open to a page that discusses the detection of ST elevation in electrocardiograms (ECGs). The text on the page mentions the use of electrodes for simultaneous acquisition through NI-ELVIS and Patient Monitor systems, estimating heart rate accuracy at about 90%. It also notes that the sensitivity of the ELVIS acquisition system was not as high as that of the Patient Monitor.
